I added `discount_cents: int = 0` to `Invoice` in `src/billing/invoices.py`. It follows the `*_cents` naming of the other money fields. I didn't run anything or add tests.

The field is stored but not used anywhere yet. `finalize()` still posts `subtotal_cents + tax_cents` to the ledger, so a discount won't reduce the amount until you change that. If you want it applied, the amount would become `subtotal_cents - discount_cents + tax_cents`. That depends on whether tax is computed before or after the discount, so I left it alone.

`finalize()` isn't idempotent, so a repeated call would post to the ledger again. Use `finalize_once()` for any caller that might finalize the same invoice twice.
